name: ahde
description: Agent Harness Development Environment — build, run, trace, eval, improve project-specific agents

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.json && chmod +x dist/cli.js
scripts.acceptance:pilot: npm run build && vitest run tests/vertical-slice.test.ts tests/builder-pi-closed-loop.test.ts tests/improvement-author.test.ts tests/target-tools.test.ts tests/world-run.test.ts tests/simulated-user.test.ts tests/python-agent.test.ts tests/python-bridges.test.ts tests/rag-xray.test.ts tests/failure-intake.test.ts tests/workbench-production-failure.test.ts tests/rag-xray-surfaces.test.ts tests/executive-version-card.test.ts tests/passport-presentation.test.ts
scripts.acceptance:guided: vitest run tests/builder-conversation-lifecycle.test.ts tests/builder-jobs.test.ts tests/builder-pi-natural-language.test.ts tests/builder-pi-closed-loop.test.ts tests/builder-pi-workshop-loop.test.ts tests/workbench-composites.test.ts tests/evidence-comparison.test.ts
scripts.vendor:build: cd vendor/pi-mono && npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm run hydrate:model-data && npm run build:offline
scripts.vendor:pack: for p in telemetry ai agent protocol client tui coding-agent; do (cd vendor/pi-mono/packages/$p && npm pack --pack-destination ../../../tarballs); done
